name: XDKNet 2.5.13
body:
Android TV 2.5.13, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.13 (Emby 2.0.5.13).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

This release is for everyone. Nothing in it needs admin rights.

## Streaming straight from home

- **The TV finds your server on your home network.** About 10 seconds after
  the app opens or someone signs in, and after a network change, the TV
  looks for the server's home address, at most once a day on each network.
  It asks the server for its local address and listens for its discovery
  reply. If neither works, it tries the other addresses in its own range on
  ports 8096 and 8920. It only takes a private address where the server
  answers with its own ID.
- **At home, everything comes straight from the server** instead of going
  out to the internet, or a tunnel such as Cloudflare, and back. Streams are
  no longer held back by the home connection's upload speed. Nothing pops
  up. To see it, open Settings > Account & Security > Addresses and headers:
  the address reads "Home network · Found automatically · In use".
- **Away from home it isn't used.** A found address belongs to the network
  it was found on, and anywhere else the TV uses the addresses you typed. On
  a network that only looks like home, such as another one on the same
  192.168.1.x range, the TV keeps checking that the address is still your
  server, and leaves it at once if not. Headers for an access proxy, such as
  Cloudflare Access, are never sent to a found address.
- **Playback and downloads follow the server.** If the address in use stops
  answering, the TV moves to the next one, and a film or song reloads there
  at the same spot. After falling back, it tries the home address again
  after 1, 5 and 15 minutes. A film already playing when the TV first
  switches to the home address carries on, and the next item comes from
  home.
- **You're in charge.** Addresses and headers has a new HOME NETWORK
  section, with "Look for this server on your home network" and a "Find the
  home address automatically" switch, which is on by default. Remove a found
  address to stop using it, and the TV won't add it back. Move it below the
  internet address, and the TV keeps your order.

## Also new

- Each address under Addresses and headers says "Home network", "Internet"
  or "Other", and a line under the list says how you're streaming now.
- The remote stays on its row on that screen when the list changes.
- Settings search finds the new options. Try "home", "wifi" or "buffering".
- IPv6 server addresses with a port, such as `http://[fd12::5]:8096`, work.
- Artwork isn't downloaded again after switching addresses.
- The Watch Next row keeps updating when the address used last doesn't
  answer.
- An address you add has to answer as your server.

The new text is in English only for now.

## Web app (plugin 2.1.0.13)

The web app gets the address labels and the fixes above. A browser can't
look for a home address, so to stream directly at home in a browser, open
the server's home address.

Plugin 2.1.0.13 (Emby 2.0.5.13) brings the web app up to date. The TV
doesn't need it for anything in this release.
